title: Optimizing Locally Equivalent Graph States in Quantum Computing Using Greedy Best-First Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.30738v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In measurement-based quantum computation and quantum repeater networks, graph-structured quantum states called graph states play a central role as an essential resource. In a graph state, each vertex corresponds to a qubit, and each edge is prepared by applying one controlled-Z (CZ) gate. Local complementation, which toggles adjacencies among the neighbors of a selected vertex, produces operationally equivalent graph states up to an inexpensive operation called local Clifford gates. Therefore, finding equivalent graphs up to local complementation with fewer edges and lower maximum degree can reduce the preparation cost, such as the number of CZ gates and the circuit depth. In this paper, we formulate the problem of finding a desirable equivalent graph via local complementations as a state space search problem. We apply a heuristic search algorithm, greedy best-first search (GBFS), to the formulated problem. Our experimental evaluation

translated_title: 使用贪婪最佳优先搜索优化量子计算中局部等价的图态
translated_abstract: 在测量型量子计算和量子中继器网络中，一种被称为图态的图结构量子态作为关键资源发挥着核心作用。在图态中，每个顶点对应一个量子比特，每条边通过应用一个受控-Z（CZ）门来制备。局部补运算会切换所选顶点各邻居之间的邻接关系，从而在一种低成本的局部Clifford门操作的意义下产生操作等价的图态。因此，寻找在局部补运算意义下边数更少、最大度更低的等价图，可以降低制备成本，例如CZ门的数量和电路深度。在本文中，我们将通过局部补运算寻找理想等价图的问题形式化为一个状态空间搜索问题，并将启发式搜索算法——贪婪最佳优先搜索（GBFS）应用于该问题。我们的实验评估……
tldr: 本文将量子计算中通过局部补运算寻找边数更少、最大度更低的等价图态的问题形式化为状态空间搜索问题，并采用贪婪最佳优先搜索（GBFS）算法来降低图态的制备成本。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates the problem of finding locally equivalent graph states with fewer edges and lower maximum degree via local complementations as a state-space search problem, and applies greedy best-first search (GBFS) to reduce the preparation cost of graph states in quantum computing.
